risk_note: RV1 by path (apps/h5 shared api and app entry; no money logic). H5 app-level API client: createAppApi builds createApiClient inside the App from build-time VITE_API_BASE_URL / VITE_APP_ID and bridge app.getEnv (X-Platform=h5, X-App-Version, X-Build, X-Trace-Id; no X-Channel per the contract, no X-Device-Id, no signing headers); h5_token through the bridge-sdk token manager in memory only, used only for operations that require auth (10002 refresh once, resend once), anonymous operations per the contract's security sent without a token; operations marked x-signed refused (net.signedRequest relay is a later task); ApiProvider / useApi wrap the routes, null outside the App; env entry with mediaOrigins. Rule tests by Codex in two calls (30 tests; round 2 after the Claude spec-test S1: X-Channel must not be sent), red on the test machine (red/2). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds (round 2: anonymous operations without a token; round 3: the signed / anonymous lists re-derived after main gained contract operations); the subagent's session ended before its remote runs, the orchestrator ran verify-fast/3 and browser on the same tree, green. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with one S2 (optional-auth operations always sent anonymously) tracked in followups; after the rebase onto a newer main the signed / anonymous lists were re-derived from the current contract (implementation round 3), round 2 pass: both lists match x-signed and security exactly

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (S1: no assertion that X-Channel is absent; three S2), Codex round 2 fixed them; round 2 pass

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
